free_tier_limits: Free, limited Developer Sandbox for testing; its data may be incomplete or outdated and is not for production. Intrinio also advertises free two-week trials on most datasets; production access generally requires a paid subscription.
rate_limits: Feed-dependent daily, per-minute, and per-second limits apply. Large-page and bulk requests: free 1/minute, paid 1/second. Free-data-only accounts: 100 requests/second. Requests time out after 25 seconds.
resolution_notes: free_tier: true; Intrinio documents free limited sandbox data: https://docs.intrinio.com/developer-sandbox. free_tier_limits: sandbox is non-production and may be incomplete/outdated; same source. rate_limits: published, feed/subscription-dependent limits: https://docs.intrinio.com/documentation/api_v2/limits. cors: yes; client-side JavaScript is supported with X-Authorization-Public-Key and an authorized-domain allowlist: https://docs.intrinio.com/documentation/api_v2/authentication.
